audience: IT teams and managed service providers that monitor devices with Pulseway

useCases.title: List devices and their agent state
useCases.text: List devices with their group, site and organization. Open one device to read its agent state.

useCases.title: Review recent device alerts
useCases.text: List notifications across all devices, or the alerts of one device, filtered by time or priority.

useCases.title: Check antivirus status of a device
useCases.text: Read the protection, definitions and scan status of one device.

useCases.title: Review past script runs on a device
useCases.text: List the automation scripts, then read the past runs of one script on one device.

useCases.title: Run a script on an online device
useCases.text: Run one automation script on one device that is online. After an error, check the device's script runs before any second call.

useCases.title: Find who changed what in Pulseway
useCases.text: List audit log entries by time or event, to see who did what and when.
